Feature: PCIe Device Enumeration and Link Training
Meta Test Description: This testcase performs PCIe device enumeration and link training. It begins by writing 0x0 to 0xE6004100 to initialize. Depending on compile-time defines (DM0_RC, DM1_RC, DM0_EP, DM1_EP), it invokes link_training_dm0_x4(4) or link_training_dm1_x4(4) for x4 link training. Cache programming is performed by reading mizar_PCIE0_DBI_DSP_COHERENCY_CONTROL_3_OFF and mizar_PCIE1_DBI_DSP_COHERENCY_CONTROL_3_OFF, modifying bit fields [11:14], [3:6], [27:30], [19:22] using set_data(), and writing back. A wait_on(20) delay is inserted between cache programming phases. The SII0 register at offset 0xC0 is polled via read_sii0_reg(0xC0) until (data_rd & 0xD1) == 0xD1, indicating link-up status. Similarly, SII1 register at offset 0xC0 is polled via read_sii1_reg(0xC0) until the same condition is met. Under DM0_RC, the Vendor ID is read from pcie_slv0 offset 0x0 via read_pcie_slv0_reg(0x0), the command register at pcie_slv0 offset 0x4 is written with 0x7 via write_pcie_slv0_reg(0x4,0x7), and mem_base_program_dm0_x4() and mem_base_program_dm1_x4() are called. Six system-level registers at 0xE690000C, 0xE6900010, 0xE6900014, 0xE6900018, 0xE6900030, 0xE6900034 are written with 0x1. Cache disable programming follows by reading and modifying COHERENCY_CONTROL_3_OFF for both PCIE0 and PCIE1, setting fields [19:22] and [27:30] to 0x0. BAR registers at offsets 0x10, 0x14, 0x18, 0x1c, 0x20, 0x24 are probed on both pcie_slv1 and pcie_slv0 by writing 0xFFFFFFFF, reading back, then writing final address values (0x0, 0x4, 0x20000000, 0x40000000, 0x60000000, 0x80000000) and reading back again. Finally, register 0xE6004100 is polled until it reads 0x12345678, with wait_on(5) delays between iterations, then finish(0) is called.
Test Description: This test verifies PCIe device enumeration and link training. It initializes a control register, performs link training for x4 configuration, programs the COHERENCY_CONTROL_3_OFF register for both PCIe controller 0 and controller 1 to enable cache coherency. It then polls SII link status registers until link-up is confirmed. Under root complex mode, it reads the device Vendor ID from TYPE1_DEV_ID_VEND_ID_REG, enables IO, memory, and bus master in TYPE1_STATUS_COMMAND_REG, and programs memory base addresses. System-level control registers are configured. Cache coherency is then disabled by clearing the relevant bit fields in COHERENCY_CONTROL_3_OFF. BAR sizing is performed on BAR0_REG through PREF_MEM_LIMIT_PREF_MEM_BASE_REG by writing all-ones, reading back the size, then programming final BAR address values on both PCIe slave interfaces. The test concludes by polling a synchronization register until a completion pattern is received.

Conditionally call link_training_dm0_x4(4) or link_training_dm1_x4(4) based on DM0_RC/DM1_RC/DM0_EP/DM1_EP defines. 3. Read mizar_PCIE0_DBI_DSP_COHERENCY_CONTROL_3_OFF again, set_data bits [27:30]=0xf, [19:22]=0xf, write back. 5. Repeat steps 3-4 for mizar_PCIE1_DBI_DSP_COHERENCY_CONTROL_3_OFF. 6. wait_on(20). 7-23. [Full procedure as documented].
Test Steps / Procedure: 1. Initialize the system control register by clearing it to zero. 2. Perform PCIe x4 link training based on the configured controller mode. 3. Enable cache coherency by programming bit fields in COHERENCY_CONTROL_3_OFF for both controllers. 4. Wait for the cache programming to take effect. 5. Poll the SII0 link status register until link-up is confirmed. 6. Poll the SII1 link status register until link-up is confirmed. 7. In root complex mode, read the Vendor ID from TYPE1_DEV_ID_VEND_ID_REG. 8. Enable IO space, memory space, and bus master in TYPE1_STATUS_COMMAND_REG. 9. Program memory base addresses for both controllers. 10. Configure system-level control registers. 11. Disable cache coherency by clearing bit fields in COHERENCY_CONTROL_3_OFF. 12. Wait for cache disable to take effect. 13. Perform BAR sizing on slave interface 1. 14. Repeat BAR sizing on slave interface 0. 15. Poll the synchronization register until completion.

Several system-level registers could not be mapped to the PCIe DBI register specification.

Feature: PCIe DMA Write and Read Multi-Channel
Meta Test Description: This testcase performs PCIe DMA write and read operations across four channels on both PCIe controllers using interrupt-driven completion.
Test Description: This test verifies PCIe DMA write and read data transfer operations across four DMA channels on both PCIe controllers. After link training and link-up confirmation, the test reads the device Vendor ID from TYPE1_DEV_ID_VEND_ID_REG and enables IO, memory, and bus master in TYPE1_STATUS_COMMAND_REG. DMA write and read interrupt masks are cleared in DMA_WRITE_INT_MASK_OFF and DMA_READ_INT_MASK_OFF. For each of the four channels, the DMA write channel is programmed and triggered via DMA_WRITE_DOORBELL_OFF. The interrupt handler reads DMA_WRITE_INT_STATUS_OFF and DMA_READ_INT_STATUS_OFF, clears the interrupts via DMA_WRITE_INT_CLEAR_OFF and DMA_READ_INT_CLEAR_OFF. The test passes when all eight DMA transfers complete successfully.

Configure GIC. 8. Unmask DMA interrupts. 9-20. Program and trigger DMA write/read channels 0-3. 21-23. IRQ handler clears interrupts.
Test Steps / Procedure: 1. Initialize the system control register. 2. Perform PCIe x4 link training. 3. Poll SII link status until link-up. 4. Read Vendor ID from TYPE1_DEV_ID_VEND_ID_REG. 5. Configure GIC for interrupt-driven DMA. 10. Unmask DMA interrupts. 11. Program and trigger DMA write channels 0-3. 12. Program and trigger DMA read channels 0-3. 13. Verify interrupt handler clears interrupts. 14. Confirm all eight DMA transfers complete.

Meta Test Description: This testcase performs PCIe memory write and read verification through the PCIe slave interfaces with cache coherency programming.
Test Description: This test verifies PCIe memory write and read operations through the PCIe slave interfaces. After link training and cache coherency programming via COHERENCY_CONTROL_3_OFF for both PCIe controllers, the SII link status register is polled until link-up is confirmed. In root complex mode, the Vendor ID is read from TYPE1_DEV_ID_VEND_ID_REG and IO, memory, and bus master are enabled in TYPE1_STATUS_COMMAND_REG. Memory write-read verification is then performed by writing known data patterns to multiple PCIe memory space addresses through the slave interface and reading them back. The test concludes by polling a synchronization register until a completion pattern is received.

Perform BAR and memory base programming. 10. Signal readiness. 11. Disable cache coherency. 12. Wait for cache disable. 13. Perform memory write-read verification. 14. Poll synchronization register. 15. Terminate with pass indication.

Test Description: This test verifies PCIe register reset default values and read-write functionality across three register domains for both PCIe controllers. First, the reset value check phase reads five DBI registers (MSI_CAP_OFF_08H_REG, MSI_CAP_OFF_10H_REG, FILTER_MASK_2_OFF, AXI_MSTR_MSG_ADDR_HIGH_OFF, UTILITY_OFF) on both controllers and verifies they match expected default values of zero. Three SII registers on both controllers are also checked. PHY reset is released and six PHY registers are verified. Second, the read-write check phase writes three distinct test patterns to all registers, reads them back, and verifies the read data matches, accounting for write masks on SII and PHY registers. The test passes if no mismatches are detected.

PHY register default check. 4. chk_rd_wr() writes three test patterns to all registers. 5. Read-back and compare with write masks. 6. finish(err2 || err1).

Read back DBI registers and verify. 10. Read back SII registers and verify with masks. 11. Read back PHY registers and verify with masks. 12. Confirm zero errors.
